role: second independent blind full reviewer of L0 at the announced rev3-final hash

blindness.disclosure: Before freezing this instrument the reviewer read the live corpus to select a non-duplicate task: full review reviews/L0-review-075-rev3.json (first full accept at this hash), the assignment cards for L0/L1, and grep-context fragments of superseded L0 verdicts. No verdict text is reused; every check below is re-derived from the pinned ledger/audit bytes, the L0 assignment acceptance clauses and the A0 rubric vocabulary. The prior full accept's documented blind spot (no live re-fetch) is explicitly covered here as C13.

hard_checks.P1_PIN_STABILITY: before == after for all five pins; any drift voids the review (exit 2, no report)
hard_checks.P2_HF14_TRIPLE: rows whose 'status' or 'validation_status' or 'supports_claim' key is present and truthy must be 0 (card precondition; all three predicates)
hard_checks.P5_REQUIRED_FIELDS: statement_exact, assumptions, does_not_imply, falsifiers, source_ids, unresolved, scope_caveats, class_ids key present on every row
hard_checks.P7_SOURCE_LINKAGE_FORWARD: every source_id resolves to a citation_audit row (0 dangling)
hard_checks.P8_SOURCE_LINKAGE_REVERSE: every theorem id in citation_audit.used_by_theorems resolves to a ledger row (0 dangling)
hard_checks.P9_CLASS_TOKENS_FROZEN: every token in class_ids and informs_classes is one of the four frozen class ids; extension labels only in ledger_tags
hard_checks.P10_AXES_VOCAB: content_status in {verified, provisional, rejected}; review_status non-empty on every row
hard_checks.P11_NO_OVERSTATED_VERIFICATION: no row with content_status=verified and verification_status=unverified
hard_checks.P12_SELF_ASSESSMENT_LABELLED: every row carries acceptance_authority naming the author self-assessment; a row may not claim an independent verdict it does not have
hard_checks.P13_LIVE_LOCATOR_SAMPLE: pre-registered blind sample of 5 (theorem_id, source_id) pairs with a DOI/arXiv locator, each source_id not referenced by any prior L1 spot-check artifact; live fetch must return HTTP 200 and a title/year consistent with the audit row. FAIL = locator resolves to a different work. Network-unresolved fetches are recorded as UNRESOLVED-NETWORK and do not count as FAIL, but at least 3 of the 5 must resolve.

non_blocking_observations_to_report.O1_DUAL_CLASS_ROWS: census of rows with >=2 class_ids; report the rows and whether each row's own does_not_imply/scope_caveats disclaims a union-class reading
non_blocking_observations_to_report.O2_EMPTY_CLASS_IDS: census of rows with class_ids == [] (literal assignment clause 'class column is non-empty'); report how many carry informs_classes and how many carry neither, leaving the gate interpretation to the lead adjudication
non_blocking_observations_to_report.O3_RUBRIC_DETECTOR_SCOPE: record whether rubric-literal HF-01/HF-02 fire, as detector-scope observations, without re-adjudicating CF-16 or the CLASSSEP calibration (lead-audit card astra-life05-classsep-calibration)

decision_rule.accept: all of P1..P13 pass; observations O1..O3 are reported but do not block the content_status/review_status axes of this review
decision_rule.revise: any hard check fails, or any sampled live fetch returns FAIL, or fewer than 3 of 5 samples resolve
decision_rule.reject: a sampled locator resolves to a different work and the audit row's title/claim is fabricated
decision_rule.never: this review is not a gate verdict, does not promote the node, and does not edit the ledger or any build input

sample_rule_frozen.candidates: (theorem_id, source_id) pairs in ledger/theorems.jsonl whose citation_audit row has a non-empty arxiv_id or doi, excluding source_ids referenced anywhere in the text of prior spot-check artifacts (globs: reviews/L1-spotcheck-*.json, artifacts/*/l1_spotcheck/*.json)
sample_rule_frozen.locator_choice: arxiv abs page if arxiv_id present else Crossref API for the doi
sample_rule_frozen.comparison: normalized title token-overlap >= 0.6 with the citation_audit title AND |year difference| <= 1 -> MATCH; title resolves and year off by <=2 or overlap in [0.35,0.6) -> PARTIAL; resolves to a different work -> FAIL; HTTP >=400 or timeout -> UNRESOLVED-NETWORK

falsifiers: any of the five pins moving before the machine-check and review files are written voids this review
a row at the pinned ledger carrying a truthy status / validation_status / supports_claim falsifies P2
a ledger source_id absent from citation_audit.csv, or a citation_audit used_by_theorems id absent from the ledger, falsifies P7/P8
a sampled locator resolving to a different work falsifies the citation audit row, not merely this review
re-running run_l0review_079.py at the same five pins must reproduce l0_machine_checks.json byte-for-byte (the report contains no timestamp); any check flipping falsifies it
